articles.title: Bitcoin derivatives signal panic. A weak core PCE reading could trigger snapback.
CoinEx denies claims it served as $3.84 billion gateway to sanctioned Iranian crypto firms
articles.summary: Blockchain analysts TRM Labs says CoinEx facilitated more than $3.8 billion in blockchain-traced flows with sanctioned Iranian crypto entities. CoinEx disputes the findings.

articles.title: Crypto relief rally fails to shake persistent bearish derivatives signal
articles.summary: A relief rally tied to recovering U.S. equities lifted BTC and ETH off weekly lows, but bearish derivatives positioning and negative CVD suggest the rebound may be fragile.

articles.title: Bitcoin supply in loss reaches record high 10.83 million BTC
articles.summary: Almost 11 million bitcoin are now held at a loss, while long-term holders control a record 14.8 million coins.

articles.title: Micron delivers blowout earnings, surges 16% and deals crypto bulls a blow
articles.summary: Micron Technology surged after blockbuster earnings and strong guidance, lifting AI memory stocks.

articles.title: Forget max pain theory. Bitcoin is well below the $72,000 magnet going into $10 billion options expiry
articles.summary: The popular max pain theory isn’t working out as bitcoin trades far from the $72K level a day ahead of a $10 billion quarterly options settlement.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin steadies ahead of U.S. PCE inflation data as DXY remains strong
articles.summary: A liquidation flush took bitcoin to its lowest since early June before Micron's blowout earnings and SK Hynix's U.S. listing plans steadied the AI trade that crypto had been sliding alongside.

articles.title: Bitcoin has a new line in the sand. Thursday’s core PCE could stress test it.
articles.summary: The market has found a new support level and it could be tested following Thursday's U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: Bitcoin back above $60,000, ETH, SOL recoup losses as AI stocks stage rebound
articles.summary: The token fell to about $59,000 before buyers stepped in, but the week's losses are steep across the board. A blowout Micron forecast lifted stocks and oil kept sliding, yet crypto did not follow.

articles.title: Upheaval at the Ethereum Foundation has some of crypto’s biggest names feeling bullish
articles.summary: In this week's edition of The Protocol Newsletter, we're looking at Ethereum's eventful week that started off with the launch of EthLabs, plus the layoffs at the Ethereum Foundation, and what this all means for the network.

articles.title: Binance withdraws Greek MiCA bid but vows to remain in Europe
articles.summary: The crypto giant must find a home base in the EU by July 1 or regulators will force the company to shut down operations for millions of regional users.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as AI trade continues to draw investor interest and capital
articles.summary: South Korean memory chip giant on Wednesday filed to raise nearly $30 billion in a U.S. offering.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Infrastructure is the prevailing currency in digital assets

articles.title: SecondFi loses $2.4 million in Cardano wallet exploit
articles.summary: SecondFi was hit by three separate attacks exploiting a flaw in its wallet generation software. A further 129 million ADA was secured by the team before attackers could reach it.

articles.title: Ex-FCA policy insider explains the ‘great divide’ in the UK’s crypto ambition
articles.summary: Former FCA policymaker and Hedera Global Policy VP, Isadora Arredondo says there is a gap between the U.K.'s crypto ambitions and how policy is carried out in practice.

articles.title: Bitcoin just broke below the floor of its famous Rainbow Chart into the ‘BTC is dead’ zone
articles.summary: A 50% drop from recent highs has pushed the asset into a zone historically labeled as a dead end, sparking a debate among crypto analysts.

articles.title: Gold, silver and bitcoin tumble as 'debasement' trade unwinds
articles.summary: Precious metals have fallen sharply from their 2025 highs as markets price in Fed rate hikes.

articles.title: Bitcoin could fall to $55,000 before finding a bottom, 10x Research says
articles.summary: A strengthening U.S. dollar and the Fed's hawkish turn under new chair Kevin Warsh may keep pressure on crypto through the summer.
